name: OpenLearn API
description:
This is the API for the OpenLearn platform, an online learning system where users can enroll in courses, watch lessons, take quizzes, and track their progress. 
The API supports student, teacher, and admin roles, allowing course management, analytics, and content access. 
This documentation (via Swagger UI) makes it easy to explore endpoints, test requests, and understand the system.

Note: API documentation is ongoing. I am finalizing it after completing unit and integration tests so that error-handling responses and edge cases are documented based on validated behavior.
